name: Arizona
standard: Section 508 / WCAG (current ASET Policy P1300 level could not be verified)

laws.summary: Authorizes the state IT office to adopt statewide IT policies and standards, including web accessibility.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: ASET Policy P1300 Website Accessibility Policy (current; not opened — site blocked)
GITA Policy P130 Rev 1.0 Web Site Accessibility (2008, predecessor)

applies_to: All budget units (state departments, boards, commissions, including Board of Regents) excluding universities, community college districts, and legislative and judicial branches (per P130).

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Follow the statewide accessibility model for web content (P130)
Each budget unit keeps current through its ADA/508 Coordinator
mobile: not addressed — P130 covers websites only; P1300 text not verified.
enforcement: Not verified; secondary sources claim civil action and loss of state funding but no primary source confirmed this.
notes: aset.az.gov and az.gov returned 403 (Cloudflare), so current Policy P1300's WCAG version, dates and requirements are unverified. Only the 2008 predecessor P130 (Section 508-based) was read. A search snippet says ASET sites target WCAG 2.2 A/AA, which is also unverified. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
